extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md suspects an 'angers' cluster of pavlovsky_2024 and chean_2025. Confirmed grounds visible in this report: single centre (Medical ICU, University Hospital of Angers), substantially shared authorship (Dara Chean, Beloncle, Mercat, Pavlovsky, Richard, Desprez, Fage, Lesimple, Courtais), and the text states that 10 of its COVID-ARDS patients 'have been included in a previously published study [14]' (Beloncle et al., Ann Intensive Care 2020), which is not in this folder. Enrolment window Dec 2019-Apr 2020. chean_2025 full text not available to this extractor; the overlap with chean_2025 specifically (registration, enrolment dates) could not be checked beyond the COHORTS.md assertion and shared centre/authors, so the cluster is treated as confirmed per COHORTS.md but flagged for adjudication.
unclear_items: design.randomised: coded false — the four strategies were computed from a single decremental PEEP trial in fixed order, no randomisation described; the paper does not explicitly state 'not randomised'.

intervention.balloon_calibration: coded not_reported in the main text; the paper refers to 'the Additional file 1 for further information' on esophageal pressure measurement, which was not provided to this extractor — calibration method may be described there.

outcomes: Table 2 row 'PEEPtot, cmH2O' for the Positive PLe strategy reads '7 [10–14]' in both the text layer and the rendered image — the IQR lower bound exceeds the upper bound and the median is below the abstract's reported optimal PEEP of 8 [5–11] for that strategy; recorded verbatim and flagged as a probable typographical error.

population.n_analysed: coded 19 (all enrolled analysed), but esophageal pressure data were missing for one patient, so esophageal-based analyses likely used 18; per-analysis denominators are not stated.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted: inferred as 19 from the protocol; the paper does not report placement attempts or failures as counts.
eligibility.criteria.adults_18_plus: the paper says 'Nineteen adult patients' but no explicit age eligibility criterion is stated; coded yes on the adult ICU setting and 'adult patients' wording.
arms[].n_analysed for positive_ple: set to 18 by derivation (19 minus 1 missing esophageal pressure); the paper does not state the per-strategy denominator.
reported_subgroups.prespecified: the paper does not state whether the COVID/R/Iest/ΔPaO2FiO2 groupings were prespecified.

extraction_flags.general_notes: This is a four-condition physiologic crossover: the four PEEP strategies (Express, Positive PLe, CoV, Crossing Point) were computed offline from a single decremental PEEP trial rather than applied sequentially to the patient. Only the Positive PLe strategy uses esophageal pressure to set PEEP; the study qualifies on the balloon_guided_peep_titration criterion through that strategy. Additional file 1 (Table S1, Figs S1-S9) was not provided; several subgroup results and the balloon calibration details reside there. Table 2 also reports PplatL, CL, CoV, VREC and VREC/PBW per strategy, not transcribed here as separate outcomes to keep the record focused; they are available in the table quote of the CRS/OD/LC rows' location (p. 7, Table 2).
